purpose: The site's identity page: what 'Bisulfid' and 'bisulfide' denote, how the German -id / English -ide spelling boundary works, and what the term must not be confused with (bisulfite, disulfide). Rendered only from admitted evidence; the module list below is the content plan, not content.

search_intents.intent: is Bisulfid the German spelling; which form to use in which language

observed_competitors.note: Observed 2026-10-30 with a third-party web search API (NOT Google; one query each; no rank or traffic data). Competitor content is not evidence for BISULFID claims.
bisulfid.com: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bisulfide and mirrors; the bisulfid.com domain itself did not appear in the returned results
observed_competitors.differentiation_available_to_bisulfid: No competitor returned treats the German/English -id/-ide boundary, the Bisulfid spelling, or the bisulfite/disulfide confusions as one governed record. That gap is the page's value, and every element of it currently lacks admitted evidence.
